scripts.check: vp fmt --check && vp run -r check && pnpm lint
scripts.lint: pnpm lint:md && pnpm lint:text && pnpm lint:spell && pnpm lint:actions
scripts.lint:actions:security: sh -c 'if command -v zizmor >/dev/null; then zizmor .github/workflows; else echo "zizmor is not installed (pipx install zizmor); CI runs it"; fi'
scripts.lang: vp run hekireki#build && vp run --filter ./test test
scripts.example: vp run hekireki#build && vp run --filter ./example generate
scripts.studio: vp run hekireki#build && hekireki studio --schema example/schema.prisma
